description: Indicates when childcare is available during this sub event. Each property is independent: omitting a property clears any previously set value for it. Not applicable when the event has a term with id `K7mPx3nQrT9bWfH2zL5cYv` ("Kinderopvang"), because such an event is childcare itself. Changing the event type to that term removes any childcare times that were already set.

allOf.description: The time at which childcare becomes available, in H:MM or HH:MM format (24-hour notation). Must be earlier than the time portion of `startDate`.
The time at which childcare ends, in H:MM or HH:MM format (24-hour notation). Must be later than the time portion of `endDate`.
